name: @openai/codex-plugin-cc
description: Use Codex from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.

scripts.prebuild: mkdir -p plugins/codex/.generated/app-server-types && codex app-server generate-ts --experimental --out plugins/codex/.generated/app-server-types
scripts.build:hooks: test -f .claude/types/claude-code.d.ts || { echo 'WARNING: hooks NOT type-checked -- .claude/types/claude-code.d.ts is absent (Claude Code writes it; CI has no copy)'; exit 0; }; tsc -p tsconfig.hooks.json
